name: What unexpected problems are most commonly discovered during bathroom demolition?

mainEntity.name: What unexpected problems are most commonly discovered during bathroom demolition?

acceptedAnswer.text: During demolition, contractors often find hidden water leaks around old tub valves, rotted subflooring beneath the toilet flange, outdated wiring, or non-moisture-rated drywall. These issues cannot stay unaddressed because covering damaged framing leads to structural failure or mold growth. Because HH Remodeling handles custom framing, subfloor repairs, and drywall in-house under owner supervision, unexpected structural problems can be corrected immediately without halting the project to wait for a separate framing or repair company.
acceptedAnswer.description: Demolition frequently reveals hidden subfloor rot around toilets, framing water damage behind showers, and outdated rough plumbing or wiring that must be repaired before rebuilding.
